summary: 3. The Petitioner has submitted that the Commission vide Order dated 30.5.2025 in Petition No. 439/MP/2024 has approved amalgamation/ merger as well as the consequent assignment of the transmission licence(s) of the Petitioner Nos.1 to 12 and to Petitioner No. 13, i.e., the Present Petitioner. The relevant extracts of the said Order are as under: “26. The Petitioners have sought assignment/ transfer of licences granted to Petitioner No. 1 to Petitioner No. 12 in favour of Petitioner No. 13 pursuant to and as an effect of the Scheme in terms of sub-section 17(3) of the Act. Given that we have already accorded our approval to the amalgamation/merger of the Petitioner Nos. 1 to 12 with the Petitioner No.13 in terms of the Scheme of Arrangement under Section 230-232 of the Companies Act, we also accord in-principle approval the consequent assignment of the transmission licences granted to Petitioner Nos. 1 to 12 in favour of Petitioner No. 13. Needless to add, consequent to the assignment of licences, all rights, assets, liabilities and obligations of these licensees in respect of the transmission business shall vest in Petitioner No. 13 i.e. POWERGRID Khavda II-C Transmission Limited. POWERGRID Khavda II-C Transmission Limited shall also remain bound by the terms and conditions of licences granted to Petitioner Nos. 1 to 12. 27. However, as noted above, the Scheme of Arrangement under Section 230-232 of the Companies has been filed before the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) for its sanction and approval under the relevant provisions of the Companies Act, read with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs’ Notification No. GSR 582(E) dated 13.6.2017 and Notification No. G.S.R 463(E) dated 5.6.2015 and the approval of the MCA thereof is currently pending. Accordingly, the approval of the amalgamation/merger as well as the consequent assignment of the transmission licence(s) of the Petitioner Nos.1 to 12 with Petitioner No.13, as accorded by us in the foregoing paragraphs, shall be subject to the MCA’s sanction and approval of the Scheme. Further, upon the receipt of the MCA’s sanction and approval of the Scheme, the Petitioners shall also place on record a copy of such sanction and approval in the file of the present case.” 4. The Petitioner has further submitted that subsequent to the said order, i.e., in Petition No. 439/MP/2024, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (hereinafter referred to as “MCA”) vide order dated 27.1.2026 has approved the merger scheme. Merger Approval Order has been filed with the Registrar of Companies, NCT of Delhi- I on 1.3.2026. Therefore, POWERGRID Koppal Gadag Transmission Limited has been merged into POWERGRID Khavda II C Transmission Limited. 5. The Petitioner, vide compliance affidavit dated 2.3.2026, in compliance with the directions issued in Petition No. 439/MP/2024, has placed on record a copy of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs’ (MCA) order dated 27.1.2026, granting sanction and approval to the Order in Petition No. 516/TL/2026 Page 4 present Petitioner, POWERGRID Khavda II-C Transmission Limited. Consequent to the said merger, the Petitioner filed the present Petition to incorporate “Implementation of 2 nos. of 220 kV Bus Sectionalizers at 220 kV level of Gadag-ll 400/220kV PS”, in accordance with the Transmission Licence Regulations. 18. The Petitioner has made the Application as per Form-I and paid a fee of Rs. One lakh as prescribed by the Central Government. As directed by the Commission, the Petitioner has served a copy of the Application on the beneficiaries of the transmission project. 19. The Petitioner has published the notices on the e-filing portal of the Commission and on its website in Form-II in English and Vernacular language. The Petitioner has also published the notice digitally in all editions of ‘Deccan Herald’ and ‘Vijayvani’ (in English and Kannada, respectively) on 2.6.2026. In response, the general public has not raised any objection to the notices. 20. The Petitioner has served a copy of the application on CTUIL as required under Section 15(3) of the Act and read with Regulation 5 (9) of the 2024 Transmission Licence Regulations. CTUIL, vide its letter dated 11.6.2026, has recommended the amendment of the existing transmission licence to include the transmission project of the Petitioner. The relevant portion of the said letter dated 11.6.2026 is extracted as under: “This has reference to petition filed by M/s POWERGRID Khavda ll-C Transmission Limited before Hon’ble CERC under Section 14, 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and CERC (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 for amendment of existing transmission licence to M/s POWERGRID Khavda ll-C Transmission Limited for executing the ISTS scheme “Implementation of 2 nos. of 220kV Bus Sectionalizers at 220kV level of Gadag-ll 400/220kV PS” under RTM. In this regard, the following is submitted: 1. Justification of the ISTS scheme: i) Gadag-ll 400/220kV PS is presently under construction with implementation schedule of 24 months (SCoD - Dec’25) under the scheme “Transmission Scheme for integration of Renewable Energy Zone (Phase-ll) in Koppal-ll (Phase-A) and Gadag-ll (Phase-A) in Karnataka and expected by Jun’26. The broad scope includes 2x500 MVA, 400/220kV ICTs, Gadag-ll - Koppal-ll 400kV (quad) D/c line and 04 nos. of 220kV line bays. In addition to above, the pooling station is being augmented with 7x500 MVA, 400/220kV ICTs, Gadag-ll - Koppal-ll 400kV (quad) 2nd D/c line, 1 no. of 400kV line bay and 05 nos. of 220 kV line bays under the scheme “System strengthening at Order in Petition No. 516/TL/2026 Page 12 23. The Petition shall be listed for hearing on 10.11.2026. Sd/- sd/- sd/- sd/- (Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson CERC Website S. title: Petition under Section 14 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for Grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 for amendment of the existing RTM Transmission Licence to POWERGRID Khavda II-C Transmission Limited.
